statusCards.label: Timeout retry
statusCards.copy: Timeouts keep Build in drawer-safe retry mode and reuse the same idempotency token.
statusCards.operatorEvidence: Operator reviews adapter availability before retry.

statusCards.label: Duplicate idempotency
statusCards.copy: Duplicate idempotency does not submit again. Build continues polling the existing runner task.
statusCards.operatorEvidence: Operator confirms the existing runner task id before any retry.

statusCards.label: Adapter error
statusCards.copy: Adapter errors stop the Build return path and leave final generated names untouched.
statusCards.operatorEvidence: Operator captures the adapter error and disables server flags for rollback if needed.

statusCards.label: Malformed completed result
statusCards.copy: Malformed completed results remain blocked by W151 and never become drawer navigation links.
statusCards.operatorEvidence: Operator requests a corrected completed runner result JSON with numeric ids and supported NetSuite URLs.

operatorEvidenceSurface.copy: Capture operator evidence before retrying, continuing polling, stopping on adapter error, or requesting a corrected result JSON.

importGuard.owner: W151 completed runner result import guard
